svg.aria-label: External side-elevation general arrangement of the Gestalt starship with stations, dimensions, general notes and a drawing title block
svg.text: MAIN BODY 100 m — L.O.A. ≈ 120 m incl. appendages
1 All dimensions in metres unless noted. Stations at 10 m.
2 Body is a prolate spheroid: Ø(x) = 50·√(1 − (x/50)²) m.
3 Section cuts A–A, B–B, C–C — see PLATE III.
4 Living materials — see PLATE IV (hull section) & References.
